Welcome to Solar Eclipse

Solutions & Specialists in Reliable Green Power

At Solar Eclipse we offer a full range of solutions in backup, hybrid, grid-tied or off-grid systems. Our team of highly skilled Engineers and Electricians will ensure that your solar investment meets all your residential or commercial energy needs.

Solar power is becoming increasingly essential across South Africa where access to the electricity grid is unstable. With escalating Eskom electricity tariffs and load shedding, our sustainable installations grant you complete energy independence.

  • Customizable & Sustainable Clean Power Systems
  • Highly Skilled Engineers & Electricians (Full SANS COC Compliance)
